objective: Test whether a parameter-free convex-hull relation among first-hour QQQ, SPY, and IWM returns identifies broad shocks that continue through UPRO or SPXU.

lineage.allowed_lesson: Independent equity-segment agreement may identify information diffusing into the SPY complex.
lineage.new_claim: Agreement is economically coherent only when SPY lies between the growth-heavy QQQ return and the small-cap IWM return.
lineage.distinction_from_synthetic_index_catchup: The failed catch-up rule traded the sign of an equal-weight QQQ/IWM return minus SPY on almost every session. This rule never trades a residual sign; it requires QQQ/IWM directional agreement and uses only whether SPY is contained in their interval.
lineage.distinction_from_breadth_consensus: Breadth Consensus used only the signs of QQQ and IWM. Index-Simplex Coherence adds a predeclared cross-sectional geometry test whose necessity follows from the latent-common-shock claim.

data.signal: Local Alpaca IEX SPY, QQQ, and IWM 30-minute regular-session bars
data.consolidated_execution_audit: Databento EQUS.MINI UPRO/SPXU BBO-1m where available

frozen_rule.returns: For each of SPY, QQQ, and IWM, 10:29 close divided by 09:30 open minus one.
frozen_rule.agreement: QQQ and IWM returns must be nonzero and have identical signs.
frozen_rule.coherence: SPY return must be greater than or equal to the smaller of the QQQ/IWM returns and less than or equal to the larger.
frozen_rule.trade: Buy UPRO for positive QQQ/IWM agreement and SPXU for negative agreement; otherwise hold cash.

mechanism_contrasts.unfiltered: All same-sign QQQ/IWM first-hour sessions, identical to the frozen Breadth Consensus signal.
mechanism_contrasts.incoherent: Same-sign QQQ/IWM sessions for which SPY is strictly outside their return interval.
mechanism_contrasts.required_interpretation: A profitable coherent subset is insufficient if its mean fixed-$100 trade P&L does not exceed both contrasts in the same partition.

prohibited_after_results: change inclusive containment to a fitted band
change the first-hour window, entry, or exit
select dates, weekdays, years, volatility states, or score magnitudes
combine this rule with a prior candidate
open a parameter grid around the interval boundaries
evidence_warning: This exact rule is frozen before its outcome, but all historical partitions have been viewed by the broader research program. A survivor would require future paper validation.
